headline: Iran threatens military response to US sanctions
summary: Iran said its response to any new U.S. threats would be "devastating" after Washington pledged the toughest financial penalties in history. U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is to detail the sanctions on Monday.
why: Sanctions on Iran affect global oil supply and shipping risk, since Iran sits beside the Strait of Hormuz, a key route for seaborne crude. Escalation can move energy prices and risk assets.

source.name: AL-MONITOR: The Middle Eastʼs leading independent news source since 2012

sources.name: AL-MONITOR: The Middle Eastʼs leading independent news source since 2012

why_moved: Threats of a severe Iranian response and a pledge of record U.S. financial penalties raise the risk of supply disruption in an already tense oil market.
